limitations: Kotlin reference not compiled; no existing Android Studio/Gradle project, signing configuration or physical APK was uploaded.
Android file bridge was tested with mocked JavaScript callbacks, not SAF on a physical device.
Real OS power interruption, physical Bluetooth/Quick Share and actual PWA-to-APK exchange were not run.
Portable HTML was rendered in Chromium on a local test origin; opening it through each browser file manager was not tested.
Production stock/account reconciliation requires responsible supervised verification; synthetic tests cannot certify historical business balances.
